main_text.p: rundem articulorum veritatem contra innovatores propugnandam,intra quos dum se limites continear, (sic jam postulante necessitate) laude dignam esse; cùm verò disputandi prurigine ulterius procedat, vituperio. Mediam siquidem tenendam putat viam inter eos qui nimium scientiæ huic tribuunt, atque eos qui nullum ei locum relinquunt, inter quos Al-Shafiensis, qui si quis ei operam daret, dignum pronuntiavit qui palo affixus per omnes Arabum tribus & coetus circumferretur, proclamante coram eo præcone, [illegible, ~12 letters] Hæc remuneratio est ejus qui relictis Al-korano & Traditione scientiæ AlCalam incubuit. Hæ-resium interventu invectam, earum gratiâ retinendam censet, nec tamen nimis illi indulgendam esse [illegible, ~10 letters] Necesse ut sit in omni regione qui hanc scientiam callet, ad hæreses ubi pullulant, retundendas, atque in eo qui illi studere velit requiri hæc tria, scil. diligentiam, ut ei sedulò vacet; Ingenii acumen, & morum probitatem; at nullo modo ferendum [illegible, ~6 letters] ut vulgo explicetur. esse illam ergo inter eas scientias quæ non sint [illegible, ~8 letters] vel simpliciter commendata, sed [illegible, ~5 letters] dum intra modum subsistant probanda; [illegible, ~20 letters] [illegible, ~20 letters] siquidem initium ei dedisse ortum hæresium, ut necessarium factum est [illegible, ~8 letters] conducere qui viam religionis peregrinantium custodiant, propter injurias Arabum, corumque latrocinia, quæ si illi intermitterent, non esset inter res peregrinantibus necessarias [illegible, ~6 letters]

page.notes: Arabic and Greek lines are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Arabic lines are marked illegible rather than guessed, except as noted. The Greek word at the bottom right is treated as the catchword, with a doubtful reading (ὀδυλάκων[?]). The Greek word after "factum est" in the text is not legible enough to copy and is marked illegible. "innovatores propugnandam,intra" lacks a space after the comma as printed. "Hæ-resium" and "Al-Shafiensis" keep the printed hyphens at the line ends. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
